Figure 2 and text p3: long-term stability experiment with Pt3GaK cycled ca. 150 times over a 14 day period; first plotted point read from Figure 2; final conversion 31.1% and final propene selectivity 92.6% stated in text after stable 12-day evaluation period; common PDH conditions from Experimental Section p5.

extraction_notes: Common PDH reaction conditions were applied from the text and Experimental Section: 15 min dehydrogenation at 620°C with 0.150 g catalyst and 9 mLmin−1 propane, followed by regeneration at 750°C in 6% O2/He for 30 min. Table 1 reports conversion and selectivity halfway through the first, second, and eighth cycles; no numeric time-on-stream value was computed for 'halfway'. Pressure was not stated for the reactor run, so it is marked missing; the paper mentions 1 atm only in the context of equilibrium conversion. 1000 ppm Pt loadings were not converted to wt%. Figure 1 intermediate cycle bars were not extracted because the 3D bar chart does not allow reliable numeric readings beyond the tabulated first/second/eighth cycle values. Propylene yield/rate, space velocity, and deactivation constants were not reported for these measurements.
